description.sub_name: 微機電系統導論與製程
description.sub_ename: INTRODUCTION AND FABRICATION OF MICRO-ELECTRO-MECHANICAL SYSTEMS
description.describe_ch: 微機電系統導論與製程是一門結合機械、電機、材料、工業工程、化工、物理、化學及生物學等領域的統整性學科。其目的在傳授微系統之設計、製造、及封裝之基本知識及經驗，並特別強調學生能應用先前學習到的知識及經驗，以及瞭解微系統與巨觀系統的不同。
description.describe_eh: Introduction and Fabrication of Micro-electro-mechanical Systems is an interdisciplinary course that involving mechanical, electrical, material, industrial, chemical engineering, and physics, chemistry, and biology. The purpose of this course is to provide basic knowledge and experience of design, fabrication, and packaging for microsystem. The emphasis is that students can apply previous acquired knowledge and experience. Furthermore, students can tell the difference between microsystem and macrosystem after learning this course.
description.pre_subname: MCAE3003機械製造(一)、ENGS2001材料力學(一)
description.pre_sub_ename: MCAE3003 MANUFACTURING PROCESS(1)、ENGS2001 MECHANICS OF MATERIALS(1)
